title: Project Atlas: Harbor Logistics pilot timeline
body:
Hi team,

Harbor Logistics confirmed they want to pilot Project Atlas with 40 trucks in their Newark depot.

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 3: sandbox access for Harbor's ops team
- Nov 17: live pilot begins
- Dec 15: pilot review and go/no-go

Joe Smith will be the technical point of contact for Harbor during the pilot.

Thanks,
Abraham
author: abrahamaiproject@gmail.com
